entities.name: Onella
entities.description: Capital city of the Citizenship of Aysen on Ulgrotha, named after the first Abbot Hazduhr.

entities.name: Hazduhr
entities.description: First Abbot, chosen by Serra, for whom Onella is named.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker worshiped in Aysen who chose abbots and gifted gargoyles; left Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Whose death preceded Serra's failure to save a man.

entities.name: Aysen Abbey
entities.description: Bureaucratic and cultural center of Aysen, built around 3190 AR.

entities.name: Abbey Gargoyles
entities.description: Serra's gift to Onella, protecting it from goblin raids.

entities.name: Serra Aviary
entities.description: Temple to Serra tended by the young of Onella.

events.summary: After Feroz's death, Serra failed to save a man from a runaway cartwheel, and Baron Sengir convinced her to leave Ulgrotha.
events.quote: Baron Sengir appeared and convinced Serra to leave Ulgrotha altogether.

events.summary: Aysen Abbey was built in Onella around 3190 AR.
events.quote: The Aysen Abbey was built in Onella under the leadership of its Abbot, around 3190 AR.

relations.quote: Onella is the capital city of the Citizenship of Aysen
The gargoyles were Serra's gift to the city of Onella.
It was named after the first Abbot Hazduhr , chosen by Serra herself.
